full_translation: The Lik Khon Ming Lung Phai is an ancient liturgical text of celestial protection and destiny. The Tai ritual priest (Chow Mo) solemnly invokes the guardian deities of the ten directions. May the life-spirits (Khon) of all our village people return safely to dwell within their bodies and homes. Let all malignant dangers, diseases, and sorrow disperse like morning mist before the sunrise. Pure water blessed with fragrant flowers is sprinkled to consecrate the ceremonial altar. The heavenly guardian deities look down in contentment and bestow health and abundance upon the land. The Tai Khamyang elders preserve this sacred manuscript as a living protective shield for all time.
